title: Why EV So Cheap in China

cards.prompt: What basic economic principle explains cheap EVs in China?
Order the events behind cheaper Chinese EVs.
items: Covid and economic worries reduce demand
Newcomers go bankrupt and unsold cars pile up
cards.answer: Boom led to oversupply, then demand fell and price cuts followed.
People saved money amid economic and political uncertainty.

cards.prompt: A company can't sell stock because buyers hold cash. What does it do per this logic?
cards.answer: Lowers prices to get cars selling amid tight competition.
